title.en: Send validated crypto payments directly to the wallet
title.zh: 加密付款校验后直接进入钱包

purpose.en: Remove the redundant checkout browser confirmation while preserving GreatLoveMeta payment safety and Safari-safe navigation.
purpose.zh: 移除重复的结账浏览器确认，同时保留 GreatLoveMeta 付款安全与 Safari 安全导航。

en: Proceed directly to wallet approval or payment after all preflight checks pass.
Keep wallet-native confirmation as the explicit authorization boundary.
zh: 全部预检通过后直接请求钱包授权或付款。
继续以钱包原生确认作为明确授权边界。
新增直达钱包回归覆盖。

en: Member crypto checkout, safety contracts, deployment validation, and Project release history
zh: 会员加密结账、安全契约、发布验证及 Project 发布历史

en: Remove window.confirm and USER_CANCELLED from ordinary payment.
Preserve lookup, RefID, balances, gas, simulation, approvals, receipts, subscription reconciliation, and full-document protected navigation.
zh: 从普通付款中移除 window.confirm 与 USER_CANCELLED。
更新直达钱包双语说明。
保留查找、RefID、余额、Gas、模拟、授权、回执、订阅核对及受保护页面全页导航。

en: Run zero-warning lint, SmartPay3 compilation, production build, complete tests including protected-navigation checks, deployment gates, and production asset verification.
zh: 执行零警告 lint、SmartPay3 编译、生产构建、含受保护导航检查的完整测试、发布门禁及生产资源核验。

en: No real wallet approval, payment, subscription purchase, or contract administration is executed.
zh: 本次不执行真实钱包授权、付款、订阅购买或合约管理。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, products, rewards, authentication, data, media, Safari navigation behavior, and independent Cloudflare resources.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、产品、奖励、身份验证、数据、媒体、Safari 导航行为及独立 Cloudflare 资源。
